d: When Reno stands trial for the murder of Buzzy Burrell, his quest for justice is complicated by Lt. Dutch Dixon who plans to insure that Reno never makes it to court alive.
As Reno waits out his pending appeal for murder, he is transfered to Paso Perdido Penitentiary where he finds himself in danger from the prison population as well as the law.
When Reno is saved during a bar fight by a man strongly resembling Elvis Presley, he attempts to track down 'the King' to express his thanks as well as satisfy his curiosity.
Reno goes to the aid of his Karate Master when one of the master's former pupils attacks a San Francisco councilwoman.

st: Way Down Yonder In New Orleans
d: When Reno goes to New Orleans after cold-blooded murderer, he finds himself the recipient of a 'dead man's curse'.
Reno saddles up to help when a friend of Bobby's is injured after uncovering a group of cattle rustlers operating through a traveling rodeo.
Reno and Cheyenne must pump themselves up when they go after a former weight lifter turned drug dealer
Reno finds himself an unwilling celebrity while in San Diego tracking a 'rave' party coordinator who is responsible for the near death of a teenage party goer.
Reno finds himself as prey in the middle of a dangerous 'hunt' after he and Bobby meet up with a former protege of Sixkiller Enterprises.
When Reno locates a missing teen, he finds it nearly impossible to persuade her to leave her seemingly comfortable life as a high-priced call girl.
Reno finds himself in a dangerous web when his former partner turns to him for help in locating a dirty cop she testified against who has now issued a 'contract' on her life.
Bobby finds his liquid assets quickly evaporating when his banker embezzles 150 million dollars and heads to sunny Mexico.
Reno and Bobby get more than they gambled for when they head to Las Vegas in pursuit of an escaped bank robber suffering from multiple personalities.
Bobby gets a new lesson in fear when he heads up to Santa Barbara State College after a serial killer responsible for the disappearance of 5 coeds.
Reno tackles a new profession while trying to flush out the killer of 3 'Repo Men'.
Reno attempts to capture a murderer while meeting with a local Real Estate dealer, which results in the real estate dealer's death during a gunfire exchange.
Reno finds himself in a precarious situation when he becomes the latest target of a bounty hunter known as a 'living legend' as well as Bobby's teacher and mentor.
Reno finds his patience tested while attempting to protect a wealthy socialite and murder witness.
